method: Rendered every page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi (32 PNGs in /private/tmp/claude-501/music-second-reader-2013ol/listening and /composing) and read every ask page in full on the render (listening 2-6 and 8-11, composing 3-11); the pages the file lists without asks (listening 1, 7, 12-16; composing 1, 2, 12-16) were checked on a contact sheet and in the text layer (covers, BLANK PAGE, ROUGH WORK only). PyMuPDF clips at 300-400 dpi settled: the en dashes in "Bars 1–9" (p2 Excerpt 3 heading, no full stop after "below"), "bars 1–18" and "bars 1–14" (p5), "lines 1–4" (p11); the curly apostrophes in "Barry’s" (p5) and "can’t" (p6 lyrics); "No.1" with no space (p5, twice); "J.S. Bach" (p4) and "G.F. Handel" (p10); "Q. 5 Irish Music" (bold, no full stop) against "Q. 6 Aural Skills." (bold, full stop); the unbulleted "You will hear THREE excerpts ..." line of Q5 and the bulleted lines of every lead-in; "Excerpt 1." / "Excerpt 2." (full stop) on p2 against bare "Excerpt 1/2/3" on p3, p8-p11; "THREE" in capitals throughout; the five spaced hyphens in Line 4 "A - - - - - men" (p11); the SEC misprint "which can he heard" (p11, kept); the Section A stem (full stops after "Q3." and "sections.") and the Section B stem (no full stop after "Q6"); "In the case of both (a) and (b)," (comma) and the three bullets printed once for both parts of composing Q1, with each part's instrument list printed beside its label; the unbulleted "(a) Study this opening of a march." / "(b) Study this opening of a minuet." lines of Q3; the unbulleted poem lines of Q2 (p4); the hyphen in "eight-bar"; "PREPARATORY WORK" in plain capitals; the em dashes in the four cadence lines "(ii—V—vi)", "(IV—I—V)", "(vi—IV—I)", "(IV—V—I)" (p7); and the flat sign in "B♭ major" (p10; the text layer's "b" is in the OpusText music font). Every questionText, questionContext, excerptLine and grid.stem string was also split at its bullets, newlines and tick boxes and matched as an exact, case-sensitive substring of the PyMuPDF text layer of its pages (whitespace collapsed); the only misses were the B♭ line (text layer "Bb", settled on the render) and lead-ins / stems printed on an earlier page than the ask's "pages" (Q5 Excerpt 3 lead-in on p8, Q6 Excerpt 3 lead-in on p10, Section A Q2-Q3 stem on p3, Section B Q5-Q6 stem on p6), each found on that earlier page. Every string was scanned for straight quotes, ASCII dashes other than the printed hyphens, double or trailing spaces: none. Addresses were checked against the printed numbering: Q1, Q5 and Q6 number their parts afresh under each excerpt (Q1 Excerpt 1-3 (i)-(iii); Q5 Excerpt 1-3 (i)-(iii); Q6 Excerpt 1 (i)-(iii), Excerpt 2 (i)-(ii), Excerpt 3 (i)-(v)); Q2-Q4 (i)-(v); Section A Q1-Q3 (a)/(b); Section B Q4-Q6. All 52 addresses match the print, and every printed ask has one. No git, builds or network.
